## Submitting a New Version

- [ ] Have you updated the version numbers (both of the package and the Typst compiler) in:
    - [ ] `typst.toml`?
    - [ ] `README.md`?
    - [ ] `examples/`?
- [ ] Have you recorded all changes in `CHANGELOG.md`?
